hbm.static_walk: complete over the UNION of both arms of 2 data-dependent predicate(s) (BOOLEAN_OBJECT); 683 of 4997 issues are conditional, so the issue list is an upper bound

static_walk_detail.bound: UPPER: every conditional issue is counted as if its predicate admitted it; the program at run time issues this many or fewer
static_walk_detail.rule: a predicate whose truth is device state does not fork this walk unless it gates a control transfer: both arms of a predicated engine issue or WAIT rejoin at pc+1 with the same loop map, so the walk takes their union and marks the issue conditional

These are SCHEDULE fields, so no machine file can correct them; the deployments must be re-emitted under one SCHEDULE rule.
